description: Source code for Playready license management, including license creation, challenge generation, license updating, and HDCP requirement checking, using Windows Media Foundation interfaces.

classes.name: PlayreadyLicense
classes.description: Manages PlayReady DRM license, including challenge generation, license update, and HDCP requirement.

methods.name: PlayreadyLicense
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the license with provided data and generates a challenge.

methods.name: ~PlayreadyLicense
methods.description: Destructor that resets internal COM objects.

methods.name: CreateTrustedInputAndTrustedInputAuthority
methods.description: Creates trusted input and input trust authority objects from content header.

methods.name: GenerateChallenge
methods.description: Generates a license challenge, either by creating a fake request if license is already usable or by requesting access and generating a real challenge.

methods.name: UpdateLicense
methods.description: Updates the license with provided license data, possibly re-creating trust objects and challenges.

methods.name: UpdateLicenseInternal
methods.description: Processes the manual enabling response and updates license usability.

methods.name: IsHDCPRequired
methods.description: Checks if HDCP is required for output protection.
